pubDescription: Search among the {nouns}: by name, by category.
pubSoonText: Please come back in a moment: the list is not ready yet.
pubEmptyTitle: The directory will fill up soon
pubEmptyText: Nobody is listed here yet. Come back soon!
noMatchText: Try another name, or remove a filter.
showPhotos: Show photos (they are loaded from the site where they are hosted)
printCut: The first {n} people out of {total} are listed here.
proposeSubject: I would like to suggest my profile for the directory
withdrawSubject: Change or remove my profile from the directory
withdrawLink: Ask for this profile to be changed or removed
adminNoBook: The directory needs the Contacts address book, which is not available right now.
suggestReason: keeps the people the directory shows
adminNoRight: You are not allowed to change this. Ask the person who manages the site.
adminSlow: Contacts is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
adminStale: Contacts is not answering: the public page keeps the last known list (24 hours at most).
adminPartial: A category could not be read again: its last known list is kept for now.
adminTruncated: A category has more than {max} cards, or the directory exceeds {all} people: only the first ones are shown.
adminUnready_no_categories: First choose a category to make public (or start with a template): the directory will fill itself.
adminUnready_unbound: Link your starter categories to a Contacts category: the directory will fill itself.
adminHideGone: The chosen “Do not show” category no longer exists in Contacts: nobody is hidden by it any more. Choose another one in the Settings tab.
adminConsentGone: The “agreed to appear” category no longer exists in Contacts: nobody is shown until you choose another one (Settings tab).
adminMapGone: The “agrees to be on the map” category no longer exists in Contacts: nobody is placed on the map.
adminCatGone: The category “{label}” no longer exists in Contacts: it is not shown any more. Remove it or link it to another one.
adminTeamMissing: {n} team member(s) no longer exist in Contacts. Use “Tidy up” below.
adminSummary: {people} people in the list, {team} in the team, {cats} public categor(ies).
adminEmpty: The directory is empty for now: choose categories or add people to the team.
adminHideNone: Someone does not want to appear? In Contacts, create a “Do not show” category and put their card in it: they disappear here in under two minutes. You can also hide them with one click in the list below.
adminHideHow: The Contacts category “{category}” hides the people filed in it ({hidden} right now).
adminConsentOn: Only people who are also in the category “{category}” are shown ({n} left out for lack of that agreement).
adminMapOn: People in the category “{category}” who have a city are placed on the map ({n} right now).
tplIntro: A template picks the words, prepares empty categories to fill and a team to complete. Everything stays editable, and you can also do it all by hand.
tplHelp: “Association”: team, members, volunteers. “Collective of creators”: creators and guests. “Empty”: you do everything yourself. The starter categories are created in Contacts (you can rename or replace them).
errTemplate: Pick a template from the list, for example “Association”.
tplBusy: The directory is already set up: a template only applies to an empty directory.
tplDone: Template applied ({created} categor(ies) created in Contacts). Now file your cards in those categories.
tplDonePending: Template applied. {created} categor(ies) created in Contacts; {pending} for you to link yourself (you are not allowed to create categories).
catIntro: Only the people filed in these Contacts categories appear in the directory. The public label is the word your visitors will see; the order is the order of the pills.
pickIntro: Tick the Contacts categories to show. The people filed in them will appear in the directory (except those you hide).
pickSearchHelp: Type part of its name, for example “members”.
pickNone: No category has that name. Try another word.
pickNoCategory: Contacts has no category yet. Create one below.
pickCreateHelp: For example “Members”. It becomes public right away; then file your cards in it from Contacts.
pickCreated: The category “{name}” is created and public.
errCreate: I could not create this category. Try again, or create it directly in Contacts.
errCreateDenied: You are not allowed to create a category in Contacts. Create it in Contacts, then tick it here.
errCatsFull: You have reached the maximum of {max} public categories.
labelHelp: The word shown to visitors ({max} characters at most). Leave empty to use the category name from Contacts.
bindIntro: Choose the Contacts category whose people should appear under this label.
bindDuplicate: This Contacts category is already public elsewhere in the list.
teamIntro: Team members are shown at the top of the directory, with their title (for example “President”), in the order below. They do not need to be in a public category.
honorSearchHelp: Type a name, or part of a name (two letters at least).
errSearchShort: Type at least two letters, for example “Mar”.
roleHelp: For example “President” ({max} characters at most). Leave empty to show only the name.
personGone: This card no longer exists in Contacts.
personBlocked: This card is hidden (“Do not show” category, or a card still to be reviewed in Contacts).
peopleIntro: These are the people your visitors see. Edit the public profile (presentation, city) or hide someone with one click: the card stays untouched in Contacts.
peopleSearchHelp: A name, a city, a title…
peopleHideConfirm: Hide this person from the directory? Nothing is deleted in Contacts, and you can show them again.
hiddenIntro: These people are filed in a public category but you hid them here.
personIntro: What you write here appears on the person's profile. The name, photo and accounts come from Contacts.
bioHelp: One or two sentences ({max} characters at most).
cityHelp: For example “Namur”. Only the city is shown, never an address.
personMapOff: The map is not turned on (setting “agrees to be on the map”).
personMapYes: This person agreed to be on the map: the city will be placed on the map when you save.
personMapNo: This person did not agree to be on the map: the city is shown but never placed on a map.
personGeoNow: Current position on the map (rounded to the city): {lat}, {lng}.
personSavedPlaced: Profile of {name} saved. City placed on the map: {place}.
errCityNone: I could not find this city. Check the spelling, for example “Namur, Belgium”.
errCityDown: The service that locates cities is not answering. Try again in a moment, or save without a city.
errTooLong: That is too long: {max} characters at most.
errSave: I could not save. Try again.
errTooMany: You have reached the limit of what the directory can keep ({max}).
tidyIntro: After cards were merged or deleted in Contacts, click here: the directory follows merged cards and forgets the ones that no longer exist.
tidyDone: Done: {followed} card(s) followed, {removed} forgotten, {cats} categor(ies) followed.
